grid: 3 s from video onset, 50 Hz (20-ms steps), causal alignment to the sound

columns.1-80: Whisper log-mel, 80 bands (2 frames of 10 ms averaged)
columns.81-144: openai/whisper-small encoder layer 12, PCA 64 (fitted on the public speech windows)

audio: mono 16 kHz; no audio track -> silence; padded to Whisper's 30 s
normalisation: none: fit scaling on videos 1-1000 before use (our model: z-score per feature)
pca_source: ICASSP 2023 Auditory EEG Decoding Challenge data (SparrKULee subset), CC BY-NC 4.0
